scope: Join one exact type/raw-name NTFS3.0/3.1 ordinary stream from captured base/extension FILE records. Reuse actual FILE restoration, attribute/list/run decoders. Supply a typed owned stream only after complete reference/ownership/VCN checks. Native record acquisition, nonresident attribute-list acquisition, arbitrary MFT lookup, namespace/content and original full NTFS remain required later work, not waived by this unit.
ownership: Private C++14 runtime/capture/ntfs_stream.h/.cpp, no concrete provider, OS, filesystem opening, callback, native process or public ABI. Record views borrow readable stable bytes; result owns all values and has no dangling input views. Caller objects/spans are valid/disjoint/stable; not a hostile C++ caller or concurrent-mutation boundary.
inputs: Request owns source_id(1..128 valid UTF8 bytes/no NUL), nonzero epoch, exact volume offset/length, cluster bytes(512..2097152 power2), positive cluster count fitting that window, record bytes(512..49152 multiple512), version3.0/3.1, full base reference with nonzero sequence, known type16..256 step16 and exact raw UTF16LE name(0..510 even bytes). Every supplied record has asserted identical context and a unique48-bit ordinal. Bad controls/null nonempty view/oversized raw record throw invalid_argument before parsing. Missing, duplicate or mismatched record facts are explicit unresolved observations. These assertions are not source provenance or current-source authority.
limits: Defaults:64 supplied records,262144 supplied record bytes,512 attribute headers,512 list entries,512 runs,1048576 report bytes. Hard maxima:256 records,1048576 supplied bytes,4096 attributes/list entries/runs and1048576 output; minimum output16384. Invalid limits throw. Valid inputs exceeding selected count/byte quotas or parser/output budgets return an explicit stopped diagnostic and no usable stream. All counters are global to this join; no silent truncation/clamping/extra records. Fixed report reserve4096, conservative per-record/part256 and per-run192 charges precede variable retention.
records: Validate context and duplicate ordinals before decoding. Lazily decode only base/selected extensions; require exact declared record size, safe FILE fixups, in-use known flags1 or3, nonzero matching sequence and exact owner: base_reference0 for base, requested full reference for extensions. When USA offset>=48, the existing optional32-bit on-record number must equal the full supplied ordinal; do not truncate a48-bit ordinal to match. Require complete bounded attribute framing and unique attribute instance IDs within each consumed record; unrelated opaque feature/type attributes do not grant capability or block an otherwise bounded requested stream.
selection: Without ATTRIBUTE_LIST, select exactly one base attribute with exact type/name; absence or multiplicity is unresolved, and an unlisted continuation cannot manufacture a stream. With a single unnamed flags0 resident ATTRIBUTE_LIST, require a nonempty completely framed list, valid name/VCN envelopes and nonzero sequence in every entry. Unknown unselected types may remain opaque. Select exact type/name entries, resolve full48/16 references, match attribute instance/type/raw name and actual lowVCN(resident0). Reject duplicate selected(record ordinal,instance) keys, stale references, missing records, wrong owners and any matching attribute in consumed records omitted by the list. List order need not be VCN order; no Unicode collation/sort/whole-file completeness claim. Nonresident/flagged/named/multiple ATTRIBUTE_LIST and type20 stream queries are explicit unsupported/ambiguous outcomes, never bypassed as if the list were absent.
streams: A resident result has exactly one selected attribute atVCN0 and copies exact value bytes, including empty/NUL data; allocated bytes is inapplicable(null in report). Nonresident selected attributes must have safe ordinary flags0/compression-unit0 mapping, oneVCN0 first extent and contiguous nonoverlapping VCN extents after sorting. Only first extent sizes apply; preserve but ignore continuation size garbage. Decode each extent mapping with a fresh delta origin and forbid sparse runs in this ordinary profile. Empty nonresident requires one declared empty extent with an exact zero-run terminator. Allocated size must equal checked joined cluster count*cluster bytes; initialized<=data<=allocated. Reject arithmetic overflow and physical cluster overlap within this stream; no global allocation-ownership claim. Keep initialized length separate without inventing data or reads.
outputs: NtfsJoinResult owns an optional const typed NtfsJoinedStream; it is nonnull only after the complete requested supplied-stream proof. On any unresolved/unsupported/metadata/budget result, no executable mapping or resident payload is returned; a bounded diagnostic report retains source/context, counts and safe record/part/run observations. complete means only this supplied ordinary stream. atomic_snapshot/current_source_authority/effects_authorized remain false. Exact byte hashes and raw names are observations, not authentication. Report schema is a private review model, not a stable wire/storage ABI. A missing-record result additionally returns required_records: every unique unresolved selected full48/16 reference in list discovery order, both typed and in the observation. This is a dependency observation for later source acquisition, never a read/write/privilege grant. Other failures return no required-record retry suggestion; no stale/wrong-owner result is automatically retried. Validate complete list framing, reference-generation consistency and every present selected record before publishing dependencies. Conflicting sequences for one ordinal, known unlisted attributes, stale/wrong-owner records, invalid lists and all other failures return no required_records suggestions. A missing base remains one full-reference dependency. Dependency discovery is independent of list ordering and grants no access.
validation: Independent Python protected-record/list/mapping generation with expected typed sizes/bytes/runs and explicit refusal diagnostics before evaluation. Cover base/resident/empty/named and split/reordered multi-record extents, stale/zero references, wrong bases/context, duplicate/absent/unlisted attributes, exact case/raw names, high48 ordinals, ignored continuation counters, overlap/gaps/mixed forms/sparse/flags, truncated/torn/header faults and exact count/byte/output budgets. Native probe protects borrowed bytes with read-only/guard pages, verifies source preservation and no usable result after failure. Run selected primitive/NTFS capture/file/worker/frontend and dependency/header/import regressions, full tooling, source-bound context and exact artifact hashes. Do not claim unrun hosts or production source admission.
